alt: Our step diagram: crouch, drop the bag, turn only the camera, pick it up, repeat. Not a game screenshot.

data.title: The drop and pick-up loop

steps.title: Crouch
steps.body: Then do not touch the left stick.

steps.title: Drop the bag
steps.body: L1/LB, R1/RB to Items, hold Circle/B.

steps.title: Look at it
steps.body: Turn the camera with the right stick only.

steps.title: Pick it up
steps.body: Value grows. Repeat about 8 to 12 times.
